meta.title: Creative Portfolio — Brand & Web Designer
meta.description: I help purpose-driven brands grow through strategic design — creating beautiful identities and solid websites that tell a story, build trust, and make an impact.

hero.tagline: I help purpose-driven brands grow through strategic design — creating beautiful identities and solid websites that tell a story, build trust, and make an impact.

paragraphs: Hi, I'm Alex — a brand and web designer helping businesses build clarity, consistency, and confidence through thoughtful design.
I work with founders, creatives, and small teams to create brand identities and websites that are not only visually strong, but strategically built.
Whether you're launching something new or evolving an existing brand, my process is collaborative, grounded in research, and tailored to you.
I believe good design isn't just about how it looks. It's about how it works, how it feels, and how it moves people to take action.

items.quote: Alex nailed our brand and website redesign with great attention to detail and clear communication. A true professional.
